then.prompt: Remove a steam counter from Boom Grenade? (If not, it is destroyed.)

_comment:
Red printing of .drafts/boom_grenade_yellow.json / boom_grenade_blue.json - identical shape, only DEAL_GENERIC amount differs (red 4, yellow 3, blue 2, per each printing's text). Printed Crank is a card-DB keyword (ability_keywords.crank), deliberately NOT authored. Clause 1: entry counter as TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY + PUT_COUNTER (shipped arc/teklo_core pattern; 'target':'self' is a harmless no-op kept for sibling consistency - the handler defaults to the source card anyway). Clause 2: upkeep as CONDITIONAL(COUNTER_GTE steam min 1) wrapping MAY, so declining the optional removal destroys the item (release note 1: removing is optional; declining destroys) and a zero-counter state also destroys it via CONDITIONAL's else. The gate sits on CONDITIONAL's 'when', NOT ability-level conditions or MAY-level conditions - either would skip the destroy along with the removal. START_OF_TURN reaches only the turn player's permanents/items, which is exactly 'At the start of YOUR turn'. Clause 3: engine._dsl_hit_listener broadcasts ON_HIT to the attacker's items zone, so the item hears its controller's hits. ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO is mandatory ('hit' fires for any damaged target); ATTACK_CLASS_IN reads classes/talents (_card_traits); ATTACK_TYPE_IN checks types AND subtypes, so ['Action'] excludes weapon attacks. Release note 2: DEAL_GENERIC passes THIS card to effect_deal_damage as the source, so Boom Grenade is the damage source, not the attack. Release note 3: DESTROY_SELF precedes DEAL_GENERIC within one ability execution; both are closures over the same card object, so destroying first does not stop the damage. 'them' = the hit hero = opponent of the controller in 1v1 (_damage_target_player maps THEM -> 3-cid, verified at effect_types.py:928).

ON_HIT means 'when THIS hits' -- it is dispatched to the attack card itself. This card's text is 'when a <class> attack action card YOU CONTROL hits', which is the broadcast, and the engine has a separate trigger for it (ON_ANY_HIT, split out precisely so the two cannot be confused). On ON_HIT this equipment never heard another card's hit and the whole ability was dead. See tests/test_on_hit_is_not_broadcast.py.
